decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - 4.	The existing slates shall be carefully removed from the roof and stored. Where existing slates are not to be reused justification as to why and samples of new slates shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - 5.	No development shall take place until full details of the proposed method of structural support, ventilation and thermal insulation and construction, including details of opening-up to allow the intervention, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Opening-up for the work shall minimise the removal of and impact on the historic fabric.

Condition : 5 - 6.	Details of the new windows, doors, staircase, drainage and any openings for services, water and waste disposal, and ventilation, to include materials, at 1:20 scale, shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - 7.	During the works a full record should be made (and annotated if including photographs), and kept with the approved drawings and background research material in a logbook which should be left with the property.
description: Erection front and rear roof extensions to the house
